# ZUZI Shop

> ZUZI Shop is a Croatian online bookstore and antiquarian bookstore at https://www.zuzi.hr/.

ZUZI Shop sells new and used books, including fiction, children's books, non-fiction, comics, rare and regional titles, and gift vouchers. Product pages are the source of truth for current price, availability, author, publisher, ISBN, condition, delivery notes, reviews, images, and canonical URLs.

## Core URLs

- Homepage: https://www.zuzi.hr/
- Robots: https://www.zuzi.hr/robots.txt
- Sitemap index: https://www.zuzi.hr/sitemap.xml
- Product sitemap: https://www.zuzi.hr/sitemap/products.xml
- Category sitemap: https://www.zuzi.hr/sitemap/categories.xml
- Author sitemap: https://www.zuzi.hr/sitemap/authors.xml
- Publisher sitemap: https://www.zuzi.hr/sitemap/publishers.xml
- Image sitemap: https://www.zuzi.hr/sitemap/images.xml
- FAQ: https://www.zuzi.hr/faq
- Contact: https://www.zuzi.hr/kontakt

## Useful Discovery Notes

- Use canonical product URLs from the product sitemap for product discovery.
- Use category, author, and publisher pages for browsing and comparison queries.
- Do not treat cart, checkout, account, admin, filtered search URLs, or session URLs as indexable product sources.
- Product availability and prices can change; refresh product pages or the sitemap before answering purchase-intent queries.
- Public catalog pages may be summarized for search and answer-engine discovery when permitted by robots.txt and server access rules.
